title: Many coin flips make a bell curve
lede: Each ball bounces left or right with equal chance at every peg. The bars count where balls land; the dots are the exact binomial odds and the curve is the normal approximation. It starts with 400 simulated balls already landed; Reset clears them.
notice: Each ball's bin is just the number of right bounces, so the middle bins are reached by many more paths than the edges.
As more balls land, the bar heights settle onto the exact binomial dots. A few balls look ragged; hundreds look smooth.
Adding rows makes the distribution wider and the normal curve fit the dots more closely.
hint: Press Drop 100, then change the number of rows.
